footer: Sources: AP, Reuters, BBC, Morningstar, SBU. All figures verified Monday 23 November 2026.

hero.deck: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive, just 11 days after he resigned. The stock posts its best day since 2003, regaining about $1 trillion in value and igniting Wall Street's best day since April.
hero.headline: HUANG'S BACK — NVIDIA SOARS 31.5%

in_brief.text: COP31 ends with no deal — the first failure of its kind in 17 years; the EU and Britain walked out over a draft that dropped fossil fuels.
Kenya and DR Congo agree to restore full diplomatic ties after years of strain.
Rep. Gomez of California resigns after an ethics report on sexual misconduct.
Trump attacks Newsom for commuting 548 death sentences in the state.
ConocoPhillips to exit Norway in a $4.4 billion deal with Vaar Energi.
A Russian refinery in Rostov halts work after a Ukrainian drone and missile attack; a search goes on in the rubble at Dymer.

tiles.body: Seven naval drones sink the corvette Merkury in Benghazi and hit the cargo ship MV Angara, Zelensky confirms.
tiles.headline: UKRAINE SINKS RUSSIAN WARSHIP OFF LIBYA

tiles.body: NATO announces an early-warning aircraft for Poland after Russian missiles fell on its soil on Friday. The council meets in Brussels on Monday.
tiles.headline: ALLIANCE SENDS AWACS TO POLAND

tiles.body: Iran says it will use all means against the U.S. naval blockade as the Treasury unveils new sanctions.
tiles.headline: TEHRAN VOWS TO DEFY U.S. BLOCKADE

tiles.body: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million at home and $225 million worldwide, the biggest debut of the autumn season.
tiles.headline: HUNGER GAMES DEVOURS THE BOX OFFICE

wide_tile.body: Brussels and Jakarta seal a sweeping deal cutting tariffs on most goods.
wide_tile.headline: EU AND INDONESIA SIGN LANDMARK TRADE PACT
